threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still call it 'the Tube' instead of 'the Overground' when you're stuck on a train at Dalston Junction.
Caught a night bus last week, and a group of guys tried to sing 'Wonderwall.' One guy just said he’d rather listen to the driver’s playlist.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: When I saw a kid selling lemonade on the corner while a busker played a sax solo nearby—so quintessentially Neukölln.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: You can find spontaneous barbecues in parks here, or DJ sets on the banks of the Spree—it's like the city throws a party just because it's sunny.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You know someone’s local if they’ve got a favorite taco spot that doesn't have a line at 2am. Tourists are still looking for La Taqueria.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Yesterday, saw a guy juggling on the 19 Polk, while a woman ordered takeout on her phone. Just another Tuesday in the Tenderloin.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: They think the locals live in cafes all day, but most of us are juggling work and family, squeezing in a quick café amb llet before the next commitment.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: Recent arrivals often order café con leche at night, totally oblivious to the locals sipping vermut instead. It's a dead giveaway.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still think ‘cabbies’ means black cabs, not the ones with the terrifying randoms on the way to the station.
Caught a night bus from Brixton to Peckham last weekend. A guy singing Old School garage at the top of his lungs, and no one even blinked. Just another Saturday!

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: The day I saw an old man feeding pigeons while a street artist painted a mural in the background. It’s the little contrasts that capture you.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Berlin do you see bus drivers hopping off to grab a coffee while passengers wait. It's like they know we all have places to be, but coffee first!

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You can spot a local when they know the exact moment to hop off BART before the Civic Center chaos kicks in—yesterday was a real test!

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Caught a kid on the 19 Polk dancing with a sandwich in one hand, spreading joy like butter. Classic Tenderloin moment, never a dull ride.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Most tourists think Gràcia is just about the parks and quaint streets, but they miss the local bars bursting with energy at 3 AM. That's real Gràcia.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: They still ask for 'tapas' like it’s a menu item rather than just a way of life here.
